prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that we may participate in your mysteries with lively faith and fruitful charity.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos participar dos vossos mistérios com fé ardente e fecunda caridade.

meta.face: A thin, ascetic man of about sixty-six with a gaunt, long face — a bald, high, bony forehead under the zucchetto, a long, prominent aquiline nose with a sharp bridge, dark, deep-set eyes under heavy, arched grey brows, hollow cheeks under high cheekbones; a full WHITE beard of medium length, trimmed square below the chin, with a white moustache; a grave, prayerful gaze lowered toward the rosary.
meta.basis: Bartolomeo Passarotti's portrait from life shows a gaunt, bald old pope with a long aquiline nose, deep-set eyes and a full white beard. He kept the white Dominican habit as pope, and he tied the Rosary to Lepanto; the square medium beard keeps him apart from Cletus's long forked one.

sources.title: Ludwig von Pastor, History of the Popes, vol. 18 (Pius V)
